say:2:1033334001:0.text: Talion is our only son. He's been away for quite a few days already...
say:2:1033334001:0.source_cn: 我们的独子，他都出门好几天了……
say:2:1033334001:0.male: Talion is our only son. He's been away for quite a few days already...
say:2:1033334001:0.female: Talion is our only son. He's been away for quite a few days already...

say:3:1033334002:0.text: Two days! Enrica, you worry too much.
say:3:1033334002:0.source_cn: 才两天！恩瑞丽，你有些过分担心塔里昂了。

say:4:1033334003:0.text: What are you talking about? Do you have any idea how dangerous the Dark Forest has been now?
say:4:1033334003:0.source_cn: 什么叫过分担心？你难道不知道薄暮丛林现在的情况吗？

say:5:1033334004:1.text: The Thorned Guards have sealed off the forest, but our son insisted on helping those displaced refugees...
say:5:1033334004:1.source_cn: 荆棘封锁了丛林，我们的孩子却偏偏要去被驱赶的难民那边帮忙……
say:5:1033334004:1.male: The Thorned Guards have sealed off the forest, but our son insisted on helping those displaced refugees...
say:5:1033334004:1.female: The Thorned Guards have sealed off the forest, but our son insisted on helping those displaced refugees...

say:6:1033334005:1.text: One of those refugees is Talion's friend. So he is going to help sneak her into the forest to take refuge in Lunadorf.
say:6:1033334005:1.source_cn: 难民里有塔里昂的朋友。他要接应朋友进入丛林来月湖村避难。
say:6:1033334005:1.male: One of those refugees is Talion's friend. So he is going to help sneak her into the forest to take refuge in Lunadorf.
say:6:1033334005:1.female: One of those refugees is Talion's friend. So he is going to help sneak her into the forest to take refuge in Lunadorf.

say:7:1033334006:1.text: We've met his friend before; she is a kindhearted human. The custom of Lunadorf doesn't allow us to stand idle by as she's in need of help now.
say:7:1033334006:1.source_cn: 他的朋友我们之前也见过，是一位很好的人类。如今她受了难...
say:7:1033334006:1.male: We've met his friend before; she is a kindhearted human. The custom of Lunadorf doesn't allow us to stand idle by as she's in need of help now.
say:7:1033334006:1.female: We've met his friend before; she is a kindhearted human. The custom of Lunadorf doesn't allow us to stand idle by as she's in need of help now.

say:8:1033334007:1.text: Not sure if the Thorned Guards would allow Talion's friend to enter the forest...
say:8:1033334007:1.source_cn: 不知道荆棘卫队会不会允许塔里昂的朋友进入丛林……
say:8:1033334007:1.male: Not sure if the Thorned Guards would allow Talion's friend to enter the forest...
say:8:1033334007:1.female: Not sure if the Thorned Guards would allow Talion's friend to enter the forest...
